items.q: How much does oven cleaning cost in Manchester?
items.a: Each oven size has a fixed price. The price list on this page comes straight from our booking system, so it always shows today's prices.
Single ovens, double ovens and range ovens. Choose the right size when you book so the price matches your oven.

items.q: Can I add oven cleaning to another clean?
items.a: Yes. Add oven cleaning as an extra when you book a regular, deep or end of tenancy clean, or book it on its own.

items.q: Do I need to be home for an oven clean?
items.a: No. Many customers leave a key or entry code — just add access notes when you book.

items.q: What if I'm not happy with the result?
items.a: Tell us within 48 hours and we'll send a cleaner back to put it right, free of charge.

items.q: Do you have oven cleaners near me?
items.a: Our oven cleaners cover Manchester and Greater Manchester, including Manchester City Centre, Salford, Trafford, Stockport, Didsbury, Chorlton, Bolton, Bury, Oldham, Rochdale, Tameside and Wigan.

items.q: Do you clean the oven racks and trays?
items.a: Yes. Racks, shelves, shelf supports, baking trays and grill pans are removed, soaked and degreased, then refitted once the oven is clean.

items.q: Do you clean the oven door glass?
items.a: Yes. We clean the inner and outer door glass, the door seal, hinges and frame.

items.q: How often should I get my oven professionally cleaned?
items.a: It depends on how often you cook. Many homes book an oven clean every few months, and it's worth booking one before you move out of a rented home.

items.q: Is oven cleaning included in end of tenancy cleaning?
items.a: Yes. A full oven clean is included as standard in our end of tenancy cleaning. If you only need your oven cleaned, book an oven clean on its own.
